description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
